parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
Optional JSON object of additional filter knobs not covered by the typed top-level params. Booleans MUST use the literal strings `"true"`/`"false"`. Common keys, grouped by category:

**Property subtypes:** `flat`, `penthouse`, `duplex`, `studio`, `chalet`, `countryHouse`, `newDevelopment`, `onlyFlats`.

**Parking variants:** `garage`, `singleParkingSpace`, `doubleParkingSpace`, `outdoorCoveredParkingSpace`, `outdoorUncoveredParkingSpace`.

**Indoor amenities:** `storeRoom`, `builtinWardrobes`, `independentHotWater`, `exterior`, `accessible`, `balcony`, `luxury`.

**Outdoor / view amenities:** `privateGarden`, `communityGarden`, `seaViews`, `exteriorDomesticSpace`.

**Other:** `hasPlan`.

**Example:** `{"swimmingPool":"true","flat":"true","penthouse":"true"}`.

If a key here collides with a typed top-level param (e.g. `elevator` vs `has_elevator`), the top-level value wins.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
Optional JSON object of additional filter knobs not covered by the typed top-level params. Booleans MUST use the literal strings `"true"`/`"false"`. Common keys, grouped by category:

**Property subtypes:** `flat`, `penthouse`, `duplex`, `studio`, `chalet`, `countryHouse`, `newDevelopment`, `onlyFlats`.

**Parking variants:** `garage`, `singleParkingSpace`, `doubleParkingSpace`, `outdoorCoveredParkingSpace`, `outdoorUncoveredParkingSpace`.

**Indoor amenities:** `storeRoom`, `builtinWardrobes`, `independentHotWater`, `exterior`, `accessible`, `balcony`, `luxury`.

**Outdoor / view amenities:** `privateGarden`, `communityGarden`, `seaViews`, `exteriorDomesticSpace`.

**Other:** `hasPlan`.

**Example:** `{"swimmingPool":"true","flat":"true","penthouse":"true"}`.

If a key here collides with a typed top-level param (e.g. `elevator` vs `has_elevator`), the top-level value wins.

latitude.description: Center latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Example: `40.4168` (Puerta del Sol, Madrid).

longitude.description: Center longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). Example: `-3.7038` (Madrid).

radius_km.description: Search radius around the centre point in **kilometres**. Default: `3`. Maximum: `15`.

search_type.description: What kind of listing to return. `for_sale` = purchase listings, `for_rent` = rental listings, `transfer` = business-transfer listings (cafés, shops, etc. with a sale price for the going concern). When `search_type=transfer`, `property_type` is overridden to `transfers`.

property_type.description: Asset class. `homes` is the largest category (flats + houses). Some property types must be paired with a specific operation: `bedrooms` and `vacationRentals` are only valid with `operation=rent`; `transfers` is only valid with `operation=sale`.

sort_order.description: Result ordering. `default` = relevance / weighted ranking. Other options: `price_low_to_high`, `price_high_to_low`, `newest` (most recently published first), `oldest` (least recently published first), `size_high_to_low` (largest m² first), `size_low_to_high` (smallest m² first).

page.description: Page number (1-based). Combine with `result_count` to walk through `totalPages` pages.

min_price.description: Minimum price in the listing currency (EUR for ES/IT/PT). For rentals this is the monthly rent.

parameters.description: Response language for description translations. Default: `en`. Common codes: `ca`, `en`, `fr`, `de`, `it`, `pt`, `da`, `fi`, `no`, `nl`, `pl`, `ro`, `ru`, `sv`, `el`, `zh`, `uk`.

agent_id.description: Agency identifier  -  the URL slug from the agency's Idealista microsite (e.g. `gilmarchamberi` from `idealista.com/.../pro/gilmarchamberi/`). Use the same value you pass to `/agent-details`.

sort_order.description: Result ordering. `default` = relevance / weighted ranking. Other options: `price_low_to_high`, `price_high_to_low`, `newest` (most recently published first), `oldest` (least recently published first), `size_high_to_low` (largest m² first), `size_low_to_high` (smallest m² first).

page.description: Page number (1-based). Combine with `result_count` to walk through `totalPages` pages.
